description: PB-01 is the RTO code for the State Transport Authority (STA) Punjab, headquartered in Chandigarh. Unlike district RTOs, this office primarily handles the registration of commercial transport vehicles, tourist taxis, and buses operating under state-wide Punjab permits.
address: State Transport Authority, Punjab, SCO No. 177-178, Sector 17-C, Chandigarh
jurisdictionAreas: Whole State of Punjab for Tourist Permits

description: The PB-02 RTO serves the city of Amritsar and is one of the oldest and busiest transport offices in Punjab. It manages a wide range of services including vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits for the holy city and its surrounding regions.
address: Opposite Fort, Goal Bagh, Amritsar, Punjab

description: The PB-03 RTO serves the Bathinda district in Punjab, handling vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and permit issuances. It is a major transport hub in the Malwa region of Punjab, ensuring compliance with the Motor Vehicles Act across its jurisdiction.

description: The PB-04 Regional Transport Office serves the Faridkot district in Punjab. It is centrally located at the Mini Secretariat and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and road tax collection for the entire district.

description: The PB-07 RTO serves the Hoshiarpur district in Punjab, acting as the primary hub for vehicle registration and licensing services in the Doaba region. It is responsible for enforcing the Motor Vehicles Act, collecting road taxes, and ensuring road safety across the district.

The office plays a critical role in managing urban transport and ensuring road safety regulations are met in this major commercial and educational hub.
